name: spark-plugins
description: Spark 插件源码与打包发布工具（市场链路见 README.md）

scripts.build:chat: node ../app/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config spark-chat/vite.config.ts && node scripts/copy-plugin-dist.mjs --pluginId spark-chat --views main
scripts.build:contacts: node ../app/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config spark-contacts/vite.config.ts && node scripts/copy-plugin-dist.mjs --pluginId spark-contacts --views main
scripts.build:minichat: node ../app/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config spark-minichat/vite.config.ts && node scripts/copy-plugin-dist.mjs --pluginId spark-minichat --views main
scripts.package:builtin: npm run build:chat && npm run build:contacts && npm run build:market && node scripts/build-builtin-packages.mjs
scripts.build:affairs: node ../app/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config spark-affairs/vite.config.ts && node scripts/copy-plugin-dist.mjs --pluginId spark-affairs --views main,affair-card
scripts.build:verify-hoa: node ../app/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config spark-verify-hoa/vite.config.ts && node scripts/copy-plugin-dist.mjs --pluginId spark-verify-hoa --views main

scripts.build:git-repo: node ../app/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config spark-git-repo/vite.config.ts && node scripts/copy-plugin-dist.mjs --pluginId spark-git-repo --views main,pr-card
scripts.build:feedback: node ../app/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config spark-feedback/vite.config.ts && node scripts/copy-plugin-dist.mjs --pluginId spark-feedback --views main,feedback-card
scripts.build:forum: node ../app/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config spark-forum/vite.config.ts && node scripts/copy-plugin-dist.mjs --pluginId spark-forum --views main,topic-card
scripts.build:market: node ../app/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js build --config spark-market/vite.config.ts && node scripts/copy-plugin-dist.mjs --pluginId spark-market --views main
